description: IPLocate is the fixed currently available dual-stack primary. Other country-estimate sources fill only gaps in this order; dissent is recorded without deleting the primary result. This is an explicit production choice, not a claim of absolute accuracy.
address_eligibility: Frozen IANA allocation and special-purpose registries; Geo and ASN use independent masks. DB-IP IPv6 is retained for comparison, never primary/fallback selection.
